route_error_interaction.rule: Global banner = aggregate platform state; route error = local route state; neither overrides the other

evaluated_options.rationale: Simplest honest model; banner from health poll, routes keep ErrorBoundary/network messages
Requires centralized API tracker — scope creep
Conflates single route failure with platform health

scenarios.note: Possible when route uses different path or transient failure; banner must not claim 'toate rutele ok'

scenarios.route: may still load or show partial errors

route_error_interaction.banner_copy_constraint: Never say 'toate serviciile operaționale' — use aggregate backend language only
